audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as the first whirlwind response: YHWH answers Job from storm, creation foundations, sea boundaries, dawn, depths, light/darkness, snow/hail, rain wilderness, stars, clouds, and wild creatures. Divine speech is treated as the book's climactic answer, not friend-theology.

verses.restored: Then the Eternal answered Job from the whirlwind and said:

familiar.text: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

modern.text: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind and said:

original.text: וַיַּֽעַן יְהוָ֣ה אֶת אִ֭יּוֹב מנ הסערה וַיֹּאמַֽר

verses.restored: Who is this darkening counsel by words without knowledge?

familiar.text: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

modern.text: “Who is this who obscures My counsel by words without knowledge?

original.text: מִ֤י זֶ֨ה מַחְשִׁ֖יךְ עֵצָ֥ה בְמִלִּ֗ין בְּֽלִי דָֽעַת

verses.restored: Gird your loins like a strong man; I will ask you, and you make it known to me.

familiar.text: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.

modern.text: Now brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall inform Me.

original.text: אֱזָר נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ וְ֝אֶשְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי

verses.restored: Where were you when I founded the earth? Tell, if you know understanding.

familiar.text: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.

modern.text: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell Me, if you have understanding.

original.text: אֵיפֹ֣ה הָ֭יִיתָ בְּיָסְדִי אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם יָדַ֥עְתָּ בִינָֽה

verses.restored: Who set its measurements, if you know? Or who stretched a line upon it?

familiar.text: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?

modern.text: Who fixed its measurements? Surely you know! Or who stretched a measuring line across it?

original.text: מִי שָׂ֣ם מְ֭מַדֶּיהָ כִּ֣י תֵדָ֑ע א֤וֹ מִֽי נָטָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יהָ קָּֽו

verses.restored: On what were its bases sunk, or who laid its cornerstone,

familiar.text: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;

modern.text: On what were its foundations set, or who laid its cornerstone,

original.text: עַל מָ֭ה אֲדָנֶ֣יהָ הָטְבָּ֑עוּ א֥וֹ מִֽי יָ֝רָ֗ה אֶ֣בֶן פִּנָּתָֽהּ

verses.restored: when the morning stars sang together and all the sons of the Divine shouted for joy?

familiar.text: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

modern.text: while the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

original.text: בְּרָן יַ֭חַד כּ֣וֹכְבֵי בֹ֑קֶר וַ֝יָּרִ֗יעוּ כָּל בְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: Who shut in the sea with doors when it burst out from the womb,

familiar.text: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?

modern.text: Who enclosed the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb,

original.text: וַיָּ֣סֶךְ בִּדְלָתַ֣יִם יָ֑ם בְּ֝גִיח֗וֹ מֵרֶ֥חֶם יֵצֵֽא

verses.restored: when I made cloud its garment and thick darkness its swaddling band,

familiar.text: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

modern.text: when I made the clouds its garment and thick darkness its blanket,

original.text: בְּשׂוּמִ֣י עָנָ֣ן לְבֻשׁ֑וֹ וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל חֲתֻלָּתֽוֹ

verses.restored: and prescribed my limit for it and set bars and doors,

familiar.text: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,

modern.text: when I fixed its boundaries and set in place its bars and doors,

original.text: וָאֶשְׁבֹּ֣ר עָלָ֣יו חֻקִּ֑י וָֽ֝אָשִׂ֗ים בְּרִ֣יחַ וּדְלָתָֽיִם

verses.restored: and said, To here you may come, and no farther; here your proud waves shall stop?

familiar.text: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

modern.text: and I declared: ‘You may come this far, but no farther; here your proud waves must stop’?

original.text: וָאֹמַ֗ר עַד פֹּ֣ה תָ֭בוֹא וְלֹ֣א תֹסִ֑יף וּפֹ֥א יָ֝שִׁ֗ית בִּגְא֥וֹן גַּלֶּֽיךָ

verses.restored: Have you commanded the morning in your days, and made the dawn know its place,

familiar.text: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;

modern.text: In your days, have you commanded the morning or assigned the dawn its place,

original.text: הְֽ֭מִיָּמֶיךָ צִוִּ֣יתָ בֹּ֑קֶר ידעתה שחר מְקֹמֽוֹ

verses.restored: to take hold of the edges of the earth, so the wicked are shaken out of it?

familiar.text: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

modern.text: that it might spread to the ends of the earth and shake the wicked out of it?

original.text: לֶ֭אֱחֹז בְּכַנְפ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיִנָּעֲר֖וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים מִמֶּֽנָּה

verses.restored: It is changed like clay under a seal, and things stand forth like a garment.

familiar.text: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.

modern.text: The earth takes shape like clay under a seal; its hills stand out like the folds of a garment.

original.text: תִּ֭תְהַפֵּךְ כְּחֹ֣מֶר חוֹתָ֑ם וְ֝יִֽתְיַצְּב֗וּ כְּמ֣וֹ לְבֽוּשׁ

verses.restored: From the wicked their light is withheld, and the raised arm is broken.

familiar.text: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.

modern.text: Light is withheld from the wicked, and their upraised arm is broken.

original.text: וְיִמָּנַ֣ע מֵרְשָׁעִ֣ים אוֹרָ֑ם וּזְר֥וֹעַ רָ֝מָ֗ה תִּשָּׁבֵֽר

verses.restored: Have you entered the springs of the sea, or walked in the recesses of the deep?

familiar.text: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?

modern.text: Have you journeyed to the vents of the sea or walked in the trenches of the deep?

original.text: הֲ֭בָאתָ עַד נִבְכֵי יָ֑ם וּבְחֵ֥קֶר תְּ֝ה֗וֹם הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ

verses.restored: Have the gates of death been revealed to you, or have you seen the gates of deep shadow?

familiar.text: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?

modern.text: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

original.text: הֲנִגְל֣וּ לְ֭ךָ שַׁעֲרֵי מָ֑וֶת וְשַׁעֲרֵ֖י צַלְמָ֣וֶת תִּרְאֶֽה

verses.restored: Have you understood the breadth of the earth? Tell, if you know all this.

familiar.text: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.

modern.text: Have you surveyed the extent of the earth? Tell Me, if you know all this.

original.text: הִ֭תְבֹּנַנְתָּ עַד רַחֲבֵי אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ

verses.restored: Where is the way to the dwelling of light, and darkness, where is its place,

familiar.text: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,

modern.text: Where is the way to the home of light? Do you know where darkness resides,

original.text: אֵי זֶ֣ה הַ֭דֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁכָּן א֑וֹר וְ֝חֹ֗שֶׁךְ אֵי זֶ֥ה מְקֹמֽוֹ

verses.restored: that you may take it to its boundary and discern the paths to its house?

familiar.text: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?

modern.text: so you can lead it back to its border? Do you know the paths to its home?

original.text: כִּ֣י תִ֭קָּחֶנּוּ אֶל גְּבוּל֑וֹ וְכִֽי תָ֝בִ֗ין נְתִיב֥וֹת בֵּיתֽוֹ

verses.restored: You know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

familiar.text: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?

modern.text: Surely you know, for you were already born! And the number of your days is great!

original.text: יָ֭דַעְתָּ כִּי אָ֣ז תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וּמִסְפַּ֖ר יָמֶ֣יךָ רַבִּֽים

verses.restored: Have you entered the storehouses of snow, or seen the storehouses of hail,

familiar.text: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,

modern.text: Have you entered the storehouses of snow or observed the storehouses of hail,

original.text: הֲ֭בָאתָ אֶל אֹצְר֣וֹת שָׁ֑לֶג וְאֹצְר֖וֹת בָּרָ֣ד תִּרְאֶֽה

verses.restored: which I have kept for the time of distress, for the day of battle and war?

familiar.text: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

modern.text: which I hold in reserve for times of trouble, for the day of war and battle?

original.text: אֲשֶׁר חָשַׂ֥כְתִּי לְעֶת צָ֑ר לְי֥וֹם קְ֝רָ֗ב וּמִלְחָמָֽה

verses.restored: By what way is light divided, or the east wind scattered over the earth?

familiar.text: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?

modern.text: In which direction is the lightning dispersed, or the east wind scattered over the earth?

original.text: אֵי זֶ֣ה הַ֭דֶּרֶךְ יֵחָ֣לֶק א֑וֹר יָפֵ֖ץ קָדִ֣ים עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Who has cut a channel for the flood, or a way for the thunderbolt,

familiar.text: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;

modern.text: Who cuts a channel for the flood or clears a path for the thunderbolt,

original.text: מִֽי פִלַּ֣ג לַשֶּׁ֣טֶף תְּעָלָ֑ה וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת

verses.restored: to bring rain on a land with no human, on wilderness where no person is,

familiar.text: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

modern.text: to bring rain on a barren land, on a desert where no man lives,

original.text: לְ֭הַמְטִיר עַל אֶ֣רֶץ לֹא אִ֑ישׁ מִ֝דְבָּ֗ר לֹא אָדָ֥ם בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: to satisfy waste and desolation, and make the tender grass sprout?

familiar.text: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

modern.text: to satisfy the parched wasteland and make it sprout with tender grass?

original.text: לְהַשְׂבִּ֣יעַ שֹׁ֭אָה וּמְשֹׁאָ֑ה וּ֝לְהַצְמִ֗יחַ מֹ֣צָא דֶֽשֶׁא

verses.restored: Does rain have a father? Or who has fathered drops of dew?

familiar.text: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

modern.text: Does the rain have a father? Who has begotten the drops of dew?

original.text: הֲיֵשׁ לַמָּטָ֥ר אָ֑ב א֥וֹ מִי ה֝וֹלִ֗יד אֶגְלֵי טָֽל

verses.restored: From whose womb did ice come out, and who gave birth to the frost of the heavens?

familiar.text: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

modern.text: From whose womb does the ice emerge? Who gives birth to the frost from heaven,

original.text: מִבֶּ֣טֶן מִ֭י יָצָ֣א הַקָּ֑רַח וּכְפֹ֥ר שָׁ֝מַיִם מִ֣י יְלָדֽוֹ

verses.restored: Waters hide themselves like stone, and the face of the deep is held fast.

familiar.text: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

modern.text: when the waters become hard as stone and the surface of the deep is frozen?

original.text: כָּ֭אֶבֶן מַ֣יִם יִתְחַבָּ֑אוּ וּפְנֵ֥י תְ֝ה֗וֹם יִתְלַכָּֽדוּ

verses.restored: Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

familiar.text: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

modern.text: Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades or loosen the belt of Orion?

original.text: הַֽ֭תְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּ֣וֹת כִּימָ֑ה אֽוֹ מֹשְׁכ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל תְּפַתֵּֽחַ

verses.restored: Can you bring out the constellations in their season, or guide the Bear with its children?

familiar.text: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?

modern.text: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear and her cubs?

original.text: הֲתֹצִ֣יא מַזָּר֣וֹת בְּעִתּ֑וֹ וְ֝עַ֗יִשׁ עַל בָּנֶ֥יהָ תַנְחֵֽם

verses.restored: Do you know the statutes of the heavens? Can you set their rule on the earth?

familiar.text: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?

modern.text: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you set their dominion over the earth?

original.text: הֲ֭יָדַעְתָּ חֻקּ֣וֹת שָׁמָ֑יִם אִם תָּשִׂ֖ים מִשְׁטָר֣וֹ בָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Can you lift your voice to the clouds, so that a flood of waters covers you?

familiar.text: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?

modern.text: Can you command the clouds so that a flood of water covers you?

original.text: הֲתָרִ֣ים לָעָ֣ב קוֹלֶ֑ךָ וְֽשִׁפְעַת מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ

verses.restored: Can you send out lightning bolts, that they may go and say to you, Here we are?

familiar.text: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?

modern.text: Can you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

original.text: הַֽתְשַׁלַּ֣ח בְּרָקִ֣ים וְיֵלֵ֑כוּ וְיֹאמְר֖וּ לְךָ֣ הִנֵּֽנוּ

verses.restored: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts, or given understanding to the mind?

familiar.text: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?

modern.text: Who has put wisdom in the heart or given understanding to the mind?

original.text: מִי שָׁ֭ת בַּטֻּח֣וֹת חָכְמָ֑ה א֤וֹ מִֽי נָתַ֖ן לַשֶּׂ֣כְוִי בִינָֽה

verses.restored: Who can count the clouds by wisdom, and who can tip the jars of the heavens,

familiar.text: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,

modern.text: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds? Or who can tilt the water jars of the heavens

original.text: מִֽי יְסַפֵּ֣ר שְׁחָקִ֣ים בְּחָכְמָ֑ה וְנִבְלֵ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם מִ֣י יַשְׁכִּֽיב

verses.restored: when dust hardens into a cast mass and clods cling together?

familiar.text: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?

modern.text: when the dust hardens into a mass and the clods of earth stick together?

original.text: בְּצֶ֣קֶת עָ֭פָר לַמּוּצָ֑ק וּרְגָבִ֥ים יְדֻבָּֽקוּ

verses.restored: Can you hunt prey for the lion, or satisfy the life of young lions,

familiar.text: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,

modern.text: Can you hunt the prey for a lioness or satisfy the hunger of young lions

original.text: הֲתָצ֣וּד לְלָבִ֣יא טָ֑רֶף וְחַיַּ֖ת כְּפִירִ֣ים תְּמַלֵּֽא

verses.restored: when they crouch in dens and lie in wait in the thicket?

familiar.text: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?

modern.text: when they crouch in their dens and lie in wait in the thicket?

original.text: כִּי יָשֹׁ֥חוּ בַמְּעוֹנ֑וֹת יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַסֻּכָּ֣ה לְמוֹ אָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Who provides for the raven its food, when its young cry to the Divine and wander without food?

familiar.text: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.

modern.text: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God as they wander about for lack of food?

original.text: מִ֤י יָכִ֥ין לָעֹרֵ֗ב צֵ֫יד֥וֹ כִּֽי ילדו אֶל אֵ֣ל יְשַׁוֵּ֑עוּ יִ֝תְע֗וּ לִבְלִי אֹֽכֶל
